_why: Real data with the CURRENT kill schema: sides, coordinates and attacker_place/victim_place. The older kills_slice.json predates all three and is kept alongside this one so the missing-side fallback in is_trade() stays covered.
_frames: Thinned to a window around each kill - analyze.py only ever reads the last frame at or before an event tick, so this preserves every alive-count and spacing figure while keeping the fixture small enough to read.
_utility: Utility for the same five rounds. Included so the tests can assert the invariants that matter: every throw has a matching detonation, every window is start<=end, and flashes/HEs carry a round number even though their source event table has none.
_loadouts: Loadouts for the same frames, re-indexed to a compact table. Lets the tests check the interning invariants: every eq resolves, every item index resolves, and no duplicates in either table.
_damages: Damage events for the same rounds, pre-filtered by the ADR rules (no self-damage, no team damage). The viewer replays these for a running ADR, so they must reproduce the parser's own figure.
_stats: Computed with compute_stats over this slice's own kills and damages, so the fixture exercises the real per_player path. Without it the chat brief silently omits rating/KAST/ADR and the coach cannot cite them.
_blinds: player_blind for the same five rounds. Kept because flash judgement is the one utility claim the demo can actually support, and because the side of each party has to be resolved from the frames at that tick - names alone get every second-half verdict backwards.

_voice._why: Utterances for the same five rounds, with the opus files left out - the tests only ever join on ticks. No audio, so no recordings of identifiable people land in the repo.

_pitch: Source pitch per frame entry, POSITIVE is looking DOWN. Carried so the aim gate is exercised on real data - it is the piece most likely to be quietly loosened, since a gate that always passes looks identical to one that works.
_shots: fire_bullets for the same five rounds: origin, aim yaw and recoil_index per bullet. Carried because hit rate by spray depth is the one thing here nothing else in the demo exposes, and because the tracer angle is the kind of bug that renders convincingly while being completely wrong.
